title: This AI Council Destroyed My Decision Making Process
description:
Most people use Claude to get one agreeable answer. This free Claude skill, the council, spins up 5 AI agents (contrarian, first principles thinker, expansionist, outsider, executor) that attack your decision from different angles, peer-review each other, and a chairman agent synthesizes one clear recommendation with a next step. It's based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Council, adapted for Claude Code skills. Great for anyone using Claude AI for real decisions instead of a yes-man. Full setup and the exact trigger phrases are in the guide below.

Get the skill and setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GqpUG1K2sO55h8QNSUgbHjK8-jbPi4jE/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
transcript: Most people use Claude like a constant agree machine, but the top users do something completely different. Claude spins up five different AI agents, each one attacking your problem from a totally different angle. The first is the contrarian and its only job is to find what is going to fail. The second is the first principles thinker. It throws out every assumption and rebuilds the problem from scratch. Third is the expansionist, hunting for the upside and the opportunities you are not seeing yet. Fourth is the outsider. It strips out the emotion and looks at the raw problem cold. And fifth is the executor, locked on one thing, the next practical move you make. Then it gets better. After all five answer, separate review agents tear into every response, challenge the weak logic, and pressure test the thinking. Finally, a chairman agent reads the whole debate and hands you one clear decision. Comment council below and I'll send you the skill.
